body.en:
Cues are index cards you fill in from a form — multiline markdown and Traditional Chinese included.
What's new appears as a short toast after you update.
Heatmaps and the bookshelf no longer show extra scrollbars.
body.zh-Hant:
提示而家係一張張索引卡 — 用表格填寫就得，支援多行 markdown 同繁體中文。
更新之後會彈一個短提示。
熱圖同書架唔會再畫多餘捲軸。
